parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.<props="china"> Call [DescribeDnsGtmInstances](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describednsgtminstances?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-29697.d_0_5_1_3_8_8.2aea3618RlSR9K) to obtain the instance ID.</props>
<props="intl">Call [DescribeDnsGtmInstances](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describednsgtminstances?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0) to obtain the instance ID.</props>

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language of the response. Default value: en. Valid values: en, zh, and ja.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value starts from **1**. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: StrategyMode
parameters.description:
The type of the access policy.

- GEO: Geographic location-based access policy

- LATENCY: Latency-based access policy
